programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Almost Famoose: Chapter One - EP 14
programme.desc: When Rocky and Bullwinkle damage the largest birdbath in the world, they set out on a musical adventure to put on a benefit concert and raise the money needed to restore the birdbath.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Crimson And Clover - EP 13
programme.desc: Clover's wild, party-girl twin sister Crimson visits and King Julien is instantly smitten.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Pineapple Of My Eye - EP 14
programme.desc: Masikura tricks King Julien into believing that a pineapple contains all the souls and wisdom of the previous Julien Kings.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Podlings / Dumpster Dining - EP 13
programme.desc: Oh's family reunion ends up turning into a disastrous family Tip and Oh secretly turn Lucy's craft store into a trendy new Boovian restaurant.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Boy Boy Girl Band / Lords And Lazers - EP 14
programme.desc: Tip and Oh try sneaking into a concert but almost destroy Human-Boov relations forever; K-Trong invites Tip and Oh to a make-believe game weekend.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle - EP 19
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist - EP 20
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1 - EP 21
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Caveheart Part I - EP 51
programme.desc: After a big argument between the Croods and Bettermans, the parents decide to separate the two families. Not wanting to split up, the kids try to convince the parents to make up before the Croods move off the farm entirely.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Caveheart Part II - EP 52
programme.desc: Hwam returns with news of a utopian cave community ("Caveana"), accidentally reigniting the argument between the Croods and Bettermans. As the Croods journey to Caveana and the Bettermans adjust to life without them, the parents deny how much they miss each other.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Hwam I Am - EP 27
programme.desc: When the Croods find a man frozen in a block of ice, they thaw him and discover he was an old flame of Gran's!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Into the Labyrinth - EP 29
programme.desc: In order to stop Moray's plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Don't Go Chasing Lavafalls - EP 30
programme.desc: Palindrome has been captured, Tony is gone, and Moray has activated his lava machine. The team starts to accept defeat, until… Tony reveals that he’s still alive! The team rallies behind this good news and launches one last attack to defeat Moray once and for all and stop the lava heading for the streets of Mexico City.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - R.O.A.M. Around the World - EP 31
programme.desc: With Ms. Nowhere and Palindrome off on a mission, the kids occupy their time playing the newest video game craze: Monster Manglers. But Tony isn’t being a team player, which leads him solo into a mysterious race against an AI car. Is someone using this game as a trap for the Spy Racers?

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Zippleback Experience - EP 19
programme.desc: After heroes Hiccup and Toothless save Barf and Belch's life, the grateful Zippleback tries to repay its life debt and abandons riders Ruff and Tuff

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snow Way Out - EP 20
programme.desc: Determined to create a key to the Dragon Eye, Ryker heads to Glacier Island to find the dangerous Snow Wraith being protected by the Dragon Riders

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 1 - EP 21
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, it's up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Costly Conundrum of the Calamitous Claylossus - EP 7
programme.desc: George and Harold transform the school's mysterious student into a giant clay monster who turns the entire town into clay

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Jarring Jerkiness of the Judge J.O.R.T.S - EP 8
programme.desc: George and Harold transform their new Spanish teacher into a superhero after they feel guilty for pranking him, but their teacher loves it and gets carried away

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Strange Strife of the Smelly Socktopus - EP 9
programme.desc: After Erica convinces them that being suspended is a great vacation, George and Harold pull off every prank they can think of in order to get suspended

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project - EP 63
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love - EP 64
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising - EP 65
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi learns about the rare species of Lope National Park, and the research and conservation done to preserve them.

programme.title: City Breaks - Belfast - EP 8
programme.desc: From a bustling old Victorian market to the Titanic Belfast museum, Olivia gets to know the different sides of Belfast through the places she visits.

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Polar Park, Norway - EP 3
programme.desc: Jamie Lowe meets some of Norway’s predators, including wolves, at the world’s northernmost animal park, Polar Park.

programme.title: Backpack Egypt - Aswan, Egypt - EP 3
programme.desc: The respect accorded to women in ancient Egypt is evident in almost every aspect of the civilization from the religious beliefs to social customs.

programme.title: Route 66 - Northern Arizona - EP 6
programme.desc: As Genevieve’s epic road trip leads her to Arizona’s raw, untamed terrain, the state begins to reveal its surreal natural wonders to her.

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 4 - EP 4
programme.desc: On his journey to Mount Kailash, Mohit finds out the role of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police in ensuring the safety of pilgrims.

programme.title: Off The Grid Gabon - Libreville, Gabon - EP 4
programme.desc: In Libreville, Emeline Nsingi Nkosi tries bush meat, explores the local fashion at a vibrant market and hunts for souvenirs at an artisan village.

programme.title: World Spas - Movenpick, Jordan - EP 12
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries many different spa treatments, which leave her skin glowing, at the Movenpick Resort in Jordan.

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Bronnoysund, Norway - EP 4
programme.desc: Jamie Lowe goes hiking in the Troll Mountains at Brønnøysund, and uncovers the folklore associated with them. He also tries cod fishing.

programme.title: London Christmas Market - London Christmas Market - EP 1
programme.desc: Deck the halls and jingle those bells! London is aglow with festive cheer, but the Covent Garden Christmas Market is where the magic really happens!

programme.title: Route 66 - Arizona - EP 7
programme.desc: The geological attractions of Arizona make Genevieve want to linger on a bit more in the state and veer off Route 66.

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 5 - EP 5
programme.desc: After crossing over to Tibet, Mohit visits a sacred site for Hindus and Jains, and catches his first glimpse of Mount Kailash.

programme.title: World Spas - Maya Ubud, Bali - EP 13
programme.desc: At Maya Ubud Spa Resort, Jamie Srubis tries different spa treatments that induce the same tranquility which Bali does.

programme.title: Boarding Pass Norway - Roros, Norway - EP 5
programme.desc: Jamie Lowe explores the quaint historical Norwegian mining town, Røros. He also goes to Flåm, where he learns about the world’s steepest railway.

programme.title: Nuremberg Christmas Market - EP1

programme.title: Bliss - Lech, Austria - EP 2

programme.title: Eternal Happiness - EP2
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers.

programme.title: The Last Breakthrough - EP10
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins "Life Force", an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up "Lung Shing Medical Centre" to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named "Ling Siu" in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins "Lung Shing" later.

They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Life After Death - EP16
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem.

programme.title: Outbound Love - EP4
programme.desc: In order to develop new business, LAW SIK-SIK (Aimee Chan), who works for a travel agency, goes to Malaysia to have a meeting with her client. Unexpectedly, her plans are ruined by a local cunning tour guide, LUK KUNG-CHI (Ruco Chan), resulting in a falling-out between the two.

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins - EP15
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho

programme.title: Will Power - EP13
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. programme.title: Eternal Happiness - EP3
programme.desc: KWUN's (YE MICHELLE) father YU (LO HOI PANG) used to be a royal doctor. Although he is a well-educated man, he believes that girls should stay home. KWUN wants to study, so she dresses up like a boy and attends a school. She meets a Mongolian Prince YI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and a Duke's son WAH (LAM RAYMOND) there and they become sworn brothers.

programme.title: The Last Breakthrough - EP11
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins "Life Force", an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up "Lung Shing Medical Centre" to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named "Ling Siu" in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins "Lung Shing" later.

They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.
